sampling.method: stratify by guideline source, language, and decision-tree complexity; take 635 pairs per class; prioritize distinct cases within strata
sampling.selection_rule: selected on the development set only; no held-out or test labels used

ablations.E2: Dataset B (6,345 MEGA-CDP pairs), class/source-balanced weights
ablations.E3: Dataset B (6,345 MEGA-CDP pairs), natural sample weights
ablations.mixed_source_10006: historical exploratory only; not the default and not part of the core training protocol

human_audit.description: independent agent semantic review plus deterministic validation; no clinical expert certification

scope: default MEGA-only paired training configuration for ASTER-CR; NLI4CT-2024 and MedPIC are transfer evaluations, with the pre-specified MedPIC development set used only for M4 calibration
adoption_basis: E1 was frozen under the development-only lexicographic selection rule: it achieved 385/420 natural paths versus 384/420 for E2, while both had 196/199 natural nodes and zero C/F direction degradations. E1 had 1/60 C/F pairs over budget versus 0/60 for E2; the pre-specified rule ranked natural path accuracy first. This is a development-set selection, not a claim of statistical superiority on every metric. No new training was performed for this decision.
conclusion: E1 is the primary training dataset. E2/E3 remain ablations. The 10,006-pair MEGA+MedEinst configuration is archived as a historical exploratory experiment, not a core training setting.
